groups.description: Audit-clean reference-core paths kept as regression guards.
groups.findings: clean paths listed by the independent audit

cases.title: Preview is a pure function over a semantic snapshot.
cases.authorization: Human/Agent may preview a standard text-only transaction without commit authority.
cases.expected: preview ok; document, revision, history, redo stack, and save state remain byte-identical

cases.title: IME composition does not submit a transaction.
cases.authorization: While composition is active, the editor may update private local text but must not reach Session.commit.
cases.expected: finish() returns no transaction while composing, and local composition remains local

cases.title: A completed IME edit becomes one semantic transaction.
cases.authorization: Human editor commits after compositionend; the adapter owns the transaction boundary.
cases.expected: exactly one text.replaceContent operation commits and one history entry is created

cases.title: Undo and redo are exact within one Session.
cases.authorization: Human edits are committed in one Session; undo/redo must traverse that Session history.
cases.expected: content, geometry, and metadata commits undo and redo in exact reverse/forward order

cases.title: Checkpoint replacement is atomic and old files remain readable.
cases.authorization: A human save may fault before rename; readers must see either the old complete archive or the new complete archive.
cases.expected: fault before rename leaves the old checkpoint readable at its original revision

cases.title: Special text round-trips byte-for-byte through the semantic file.
cases.authorization: Human text may contain CJK, emoji, tags, ampersands, and literal script text; file serialization must preserve it exactly.
cases.expected: checkpoint reopen and derived HTML preserve the exact UTF-8 text while escaping markup

cases.title: The standard text-only Agent transaction enforces its Scope.
cases.authorization: Agent receives a selection Scope for the title and may replace only that title text.
cases.expected: commit succeeds, title changes, and body/image/shape remain unchanged

groups.description: Agent scope, selection regeneration, provenance, fit, asset budget, and fact safety.

cases.title: Generic slide.update cannot bypass a narrow Agent Scope.
cases.authorization: Agent is authorized for title content only; a generic slide.update attempts to mutate the body.
cases.expected: preview rejects the body mutation with a scope/contract error

cases.title: Selection regeneration changes the selected semantic object.
cases.authorization: Agent selection contains only the title; regeneration must preserve body, image, and surface.
cases.expected: generated transaction targets the title and does not delete or replace non-selected elements

cases.title: Regeneration carries edit policy and semantic references forward.
cases.authorization: Agent regeneration is authorized to replace a slide but must retain title protection and body Fact/Source references.
cases.expected: replacement elements retain preserveOnRegenerate and semanticRefs from the source snapshot

cases.title: Regeneration consumes the caller-supplied Slide IR.
cases.authorization: Agent supplies an explicit Slide IR with a cautious Chinese title; the compiler must use that request.
cases.expected: returned draft/transaction contains the supplied IR title rather than inferred current text

cases.title: Text fit is measured against the actual fixed frame.
cases.authorization: Agent may reduce the title font to the requested minimum, but the committed result must not retain TEXT_OVERFLOW.
cases.expected: fit transaction commits only when the measured result fits, with no overflow warning afterward

cases.title: Image replacement consumes the declared replacement budget.
cases.authorization: Agent is authorized for the image but the transaction declares maxReplacedAssets=0.
cases.expected: preview rejects one semantic asset replacement as a mutation-budget violation

cases.title: Fact synchronization is safe when the prior display is absent.
cases.authorization: Fact sync targets the body with a previous value that is not present; it must not overwrite unrelated runs.
cases.expected: transaction rejects or leaves the original display untouched when no safe prior-value match exists

observed.before: Revenue was 41% last year; target is 50%.
observed.after: Revenue was 41% last year; target is 50%.

groups.description: Lock semantics and group-lock enforcement across undo.

cases.title: Lock then immediate undo is legal and exact.
cases.authorization: Human locks a title and immediately invokes Session.undo.
cases.expected: lock commit and inverse undo both succeed; title returns to its unlocked state

cases.title: A locked logical group cannot move through a member-only transaction.
cases.authorization: Human requests group movement while the group itself is locked; all member geometry must remain unchanged.
cases.expected: preview rejects group.move with a lock/edit-policy issue

groups.description: Product Host controls and browser-computed DU layout.

cases.title: A real Product Host exposes the first-user editing journey.
cases.authorization: A new user opens a local document in Chromium and must be able to select/edit text, import an image, and save.
cases.expected: file:// Host exposes contenteditable text, file input, and a save control

cases.title: The browser computes valid slide-space layout.
cases.authorization: A user opens the reference preview in Chromium; rendered geometry must be visible and proportional.
cases.expected: slide has nonzero computed size and title has nonzero position/font size derived from DU

groups.description: Page/notes permissions and executable animation metadata.

cases.title: Notes updates use the notes permission.
cases.authorization: Human/Agent receives only notes permission and updates speaker notes without structure authority.
cases.expected: notes transaction commits and changes only slide.notes

cases.title: Transition and element animation metadata are executable renderer inputs.
cases.authorization: Presenter/Portable renderer receives a fade transition and a stepped element animation.
cases.expected: derived HTML exposes transition and animation behavior markers, not only appearStep

groups.description: Compiler output quality and measured text-fit diagnostics.

cases.title: Compiler rejects AI input that produces key text overflow.
cases.authorization: AI supplies a valid Slide IR with a deliberately long primary heading; built-in quality rule max-overflow is zero.
cases.expected: compileSlide returns a blocking quality issue before materialization

groups.description: Offline portable viewer, Quick Fix, Light Edit, and local assets.

cases.title: A generated Portable file is an editable offline surface.
cases.authorization: User double-clicks a Quick Fix file through file:// and expects text editing, local image input, and save.
cases.expected: generated HTML contains an editing surface, file input, and save handler

cases.title: Portable Quick Fix imports a new local image asset.
cases.authorization: User selects a new local PNG not present in the source Document; the runtime must validate bytes and atomically add/replace the asset.
cases.expected: replaceImage succeeds for a new assetId and advances the semantic revision

cases.title: Portable save preserves the document’s minimum compatibility profile.
cases.authorization: User edits or opens a GA-B Chart document in Quick Fix and chooses Save as New Project without knowing internal profile names.
cases.expected: default save succeeds for a Chart document and returns a checkpoint byte stream

cases.title: Portable unit conversion is scoped to CSS serialization.
cases.authorization: User opens a self-contained Portable Viewer and reads ordinary text and identifiers exactly as authored.
cases.expected: generated HTML has no ordinary-word corruption from DU conversion

cases.title: Light Edit is a superset of Quick Fix editing.
cases.authorization: User opens Light Edit and expects the Quick Fix text/image edits plus Light Edit geometry/chart tools.
cases.expected: Light Edit editText and replaceImage both commit through the portable operation boundary

groups.description: Faithful PDF, PNG, and semantic PPTX export.

cases.title: PDF preserves Chinese and emoji text.
cases.authorization: User exports the semantic Document to PDF and inspects extracted text with pdftotext.
cases.expected: pdftotext output contains the authored Chinese title and second paragraph without replacement question marks

cases.title: PNG contains semantic text/image pixels and matches the pixel golden.
cases.authorization: User exports a 32×18 preview and acceptance checks non-flat pixels, dark text pixels, and exact golden samples.
cases.expected: PNG is non-flat, contains dark text pixels, and matches blackbox-goldens.json

cases.title: Semantic PPTX preserves paragraphs, run formatting, and rotation.
cases.authorization: User exports a two-paragraph styled text box and opens it with Python python-pptx.
cases.expected: python-pptx observes both paragraphs, at least one styled run, and nonzero rotation

groups.description: Crash recovery, checkpoint history, CAS, and runtime profile replay.

cases.title: Open automatically discovers and offers durable Journal recovery.
cases.authorization: A separate child process commits three text transactions, is SIGKILLed, and the user reopens the old checkpoint.
cases.expected: ordinary open/recover path returns the committed Journal revision instead of silently showing the old checkpoint

cases.title: Checkpoint recent history restores a usable Session Undo stack.
cases.authorization: User saves a modified checkpoint, reopens it, and immediately presses Undo.
cases.expected: reopened Session has the recent transaction history and undo restores the checkpoint base

cases.title: Journal replay resolves newly imported asset bytes by hash.
cases.authorization: Agent imports a new local image after the checkpoint; the durable Journal records its hash and replay has access to the bytes.
cases.expected: replay applies asset.upsert plus image replacement instead of reporting ASSET_MISSING

cases.title: Journal replay preserves the checkpoint runtime profile.
cases.authorization: A GA-C Widget transaction is committed and later replayed; recovery must use GA-C operation semantics.
cases.expected: component.updateProps replays successfully without falling back to GA-B

groups.description: Three-way review, patch integrity, literal payloads, and override debt.

cases.title: Delete-versus-local-edit is an explicit review conflict.
cases.authorization: Base has a title, local edits it, and the revised copy deletes it; review must protect the local change.
cases.expected: comparison returns a conflict/ambiguous unit rather than a clean deleted status

cases.title: Reviewer covers persistent slide and element domains.
cases.authorization: Revised copy changes notes, transition, visual strategy, protected anchors, order, animation, opacity, tags, and description.
cases.expected: comparison emits review units for every changed persistent domain

cases.title: Reviewer produces executable operations for paragraph and box style changes.
cases.authorization: Revised copy changes a text element paragraph alignment; reviewer acceptance must not return a zero-operation style unit.
cases.expected: style unit has at least one typed operation

cases.title: Patch validation checks the revised head revision.
cases.authorization: Reviewer creates a patch and an intermediary tampers with manifest.headRevision before validation.
cases.expected: tampered headRevision is rejected before patch application

cases.title: Widget patch profile follows the document capability.
cases.authorization: Reviewer creates a patch for a GA-C core/code Widget without an internal profile override.
cases.expected: patch manifest.compatibilityProfile is ppte-2.0-ga-c.1

cases.title: Patch payloads allow literal script-like text as data.
cases.authorization: Revised title contains the literal string </script>; patch encoding must preserve it as data.
cases.expected: encode/decode succeeds and decoded operation text equals the literal value

cases.title: Patch payloads allow the controlled Widget code field.
cases.authorization: Revised core/code Widget changes props.code; typed patch validation must allow the declared property.
cases.expected: encode/decode succeeds for a code Widget property update

cases.title: Override debt counts supported new local style fields.
cases.authorization: Key title adds a valid letterSpacing override absent from its current preset.
cases.expected: override report includes letterSpacing and a positive overriddenFields count

cases.title: Release evidence is independently verifiable.
cases.authorization: The GA-C label may not be certified by the same Contract Deck CLI/tests that implement the behavior.
cases.expected: legacy e2e:ga-c script no longer points directly to the Contract Deck self-check CLI

observed.script: pnpm build && pnpm host:build && node scripts/blackbox-gates.mjs --milestone final

cases.title: Missing authoring evidence cannot close G2.
cases.authorization: The authoring benchmark has no completed human panel; M3 table editing is deferred at G2.
cases.expected: public reviewer returns blocked with zero human passes and a deferred table script; this is a gate-contract check, not G2 acceptance

cases.title: Partial browser calibration cannot close A20.
cases.authorization: Synthetic Portable browser observations retain raw tail latency and explicitly unverified physical-device and Host coverage.
cases.expected: 20 cold/warm and 30 separate interaction samples for 12/30/100 pages; unmeasured scope stays unverified

unverified: 12-page original Cherry material (not present in repository)
Real Safari (Playwright WebKit is not Safari)
Physical Chinese IME and real pointer feedback
Unrelated DOM identity, text focus and playing media stability during edits
Memory peak/residual over at least 20 file/media disposal loops
Font subset missing-glyph fallback outside pinned content
Whole-product budget calibration; candidates are not release passes

cases.title: Scenario A: AI new presentation starts in a real Host.
cases.authorization: The existing Agent turns a source brief into Presentation IR; Host compiles that design into ten distinct editable slides retaining source facts.
cases.expected: Host imports genuine Agent-authored IR and renders ten distinct semantic slides retaining source facts in Chromium

cases.title: Scenario B: human small edit crosses the browser transaction boundary.
cases.authorization: User double-clicks a text box, enters IME text, sees no intermediate commits, then saves and reopens.
cases.expected: Chromium exposes editable text and save/reopen controls for the file journey

cases.title: Scenario C: Flat Group happy path remains exact.
cases.authorization: Human creates a flat group, moves and resizes it, then undoes geometry without implicit text-style changes.
cases.expected: create/move/resize/undo all succeed and restore exact member frames

cases.title: Scenario D: Agent local edit rejects non-target mutation.
cases.authorization: Agent is granted title-only scope but submits a generic operation that changes body content.
cases.expected: preview rejects the transaction before any non-target mutation can commit

cases.title: Scenario E: mixed-content reflow returns a reviewable Transaction.
cases.authorization: Agent requests page reflow for title/body/chart/metric content and expects no object loss.
cases.expected: mixed-content layout returns a previewable geometry transaction

cases.title: Scenario F: visual redesign honors selection direction.
cases.authorization: Agent selects the title for redesign; all non-selected objects must remain unchanged.
cases.expected: redesign transaction only replaces the selected semantic target

cases.title: Scenario G: crash/reopen restores durable work automatically.
cases.authorization: A real child process is SIGKILLed after three durable commits; reopening the checkpoint must offer those commits.
cases.expected: reopen result revision equals the Journal tail revision

cases.title: Scenario H: Portable Quick Fix edits and saves from file://.
cases.authorization: User double-clicks a generated Quick Fix file, edits text/image, then saves a new project.
cases.expected: file:// artifact includes the complete editing and save surface

cases.title: Scenario I: revised-copy deletion is reviewable.
cases.authorization: Local copy edits a title while revised copy deletes it; user must receive a conflict choice.
cases.expected: review UI receives a nonzero conflict set

cases.title: Scenario J: export is visually and semantically faithful.
cases.authorization: User exports the styled Unicode slide and validates PDF/PNG/PPTX content rather than just file signatures.
cases.expected: exported PDF text, PNG pixels, and PPTX properties all pass their independent checks

groups.description: GA-C Video Widget registry, poster fallback, checkpoint, Portable downgrade, and export honesty.

cases.title: GA-C Video Widget is resolved through the controlled registry.
cases.authorization: A GA-C document contains a Video Widget with a local poster asset; the host must resolve its controlled definition and expose a poster-backed static fallback.
cases.expected: registry validation succeeds; rendered widget contains a video surface and a poster/fallback path

cases.title: Video Widget checkpoint round-trip retains the downgrade contract.
cases.authorization: A user saves and reopens a GA-C Video Widget project, then opens its Light Edit derivative; semantic props/fallback must survive and the derivative must report an actionable static downgrade.
cases.expected: checkpoint round-trip preserves Video Widget props/fallback; Light Edit reports static status, reason, recovery, and degraded=true

observed.reason: Video playback is unavailable in the offline Light Edit surface; the controlled poster fallback is retained.
observed.recovery: Open the source document in a GA-C Host with the Video Widget registry to restore playback.

cases.title: PDF and PNG export a Video poster or report honest degradation.
cases.authorization: A user exports a GA-C Video Widget with its local poster bytes; each raster export must either contain the poster-capable path or explicitly report the degraded capability.
cases.expected: both PDF and PNG are non-empty and each has poster evidence or an element-scoped EXPORT_DEGRADED report

groups.description: Semantic bar/line/pie charts exported as native PPTX chart parts with capability evidence.

cases.title: Semantic bar/line/pie charts become native PPTX chart parts.
cases.authorization: A user exports semantic Bar, Line, and Pie Chart elements; Python python-pptx must observe native chart shapes, chart parts, categories Q1/Q2, and values 42/38.
cases.expected: python-pptx reports at least three native chart shapes/parts and preserves the fixture categories and values

cases.title: PPTX capability evidence identifies native charts.
cases.authorization: The semantic PPTX export advertises its Chart mapping explicitly so a consumer can distinguish a native chart from an SVG picture.
cases.expected: capability report includes native-chart=true for every exported semantic Chart

groups.description: Full Portable file:// editor surface and save-new-project journey.

cases.title: full-portable packages the complete editor API.
cases.authorization: A user chooses profile full-portable and expects multi-selection, Move/Scale/Rotate, Crop, Chart data, undo/redo, and Save as New Project in one self-contained artifact.
cases.expected: bundle audit passes for full-portable and the embedded API exposes every full-editor method

cases.title: full-portable executes the complete file:// journey.
cases.authorization: A user opens a full-portable file locally, invokes its API, and saves a new project; the browser must expose the full method surface.
cases.expected: file:// exposes full-portable profile, all required methods, and a successful saveAsNewProject result

groups.description: Explicit member transforms for Group Rotate with exact undo and Host/renderer parity.

cases.title: Group Rotate commits explicit member transforms and exact undo.
cases.authorization: A human rotates a flat group containing three elements by 90 degrees; the operation must change each member frame/rotation, keep the group flat, and undo byte-exactly.
cases.expected: group.rotate commits; all three members receive explicit frame/rotation changes; group has no coordinate-system fields; undo restores the source snapshot

groups.description: Slidev/Markdown legacy migration and GA-A/GA-B/GA-C boundary coverage.

cases.title: Slidev and Markdown files migrate into semantic documents.
cases.authorization: A user opens old Slidev and Markdown source files; import must parse them into semantic slides without treating raw markup as a document source.
cases.expected: both legacy text formats produce a non-empty semantic document with sourceFormat and migration evidence

cases.title: Legacy migration preserves GA-C boundaries and honest fallbacks.
cases.authorization: A legacy Slidev semantic snapshot contains Area/Donut charts, Poster artwork, and a Widget; GA-C retains them while GA-B downgrades unsupported content with migration issues.
cases.expected: GA-C retains Area/Donut, Poster artwork, and Widget static fallback; GA-B retains safe semantics, drops unsupported objects, and reports each downgrade

groups.description: stdio MCP protocol, Agent tool exposure, readonly filtering, and checkpoint persistence.

cases.title: The published MCP smoke journey uses a real child process.
cases.authorization: A local GA-C example is checkpointed, opened through MCP, edited through preview→commit, and reopened.
cases.expected: scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs exits zero and reports protocol, readonly, and persistence evidence

cases.title: MCP tools/list exposes the AgentToolServer contract with schemas.
cases.authorization: A client initializes a PPTe server and asks for the tool catalog.
cases.expected: read tools, preview, commit, and every tool inputSchema are present

cases.title: Readonly MCP sessions hide mutations while writable sessions persist one Operation.
cases.authorization: A readonly client must not advertise commit/undo; a writable client previews and commits text.replaceContent, then a fresh process reads the result.
cases.expected: mutation filtering and same-path checkpoint persistence are both observable over stdio

groups.description: MCP-owned editable delivery, file:// save/reopen/present, preview separation, and artifact budgets.

cases.title: MCP exposes one explicit, default editable delivery contract.
cases.authorization: A writable MCP client asks for delivery without a profile or output path; a readonly client asks for the same tool.
cases.expected: writable delivery returns editable HTML first plus the same-revision .ppte source, while readonly hides and rejects the file mutation

cases.title: The primary editable artifact closes the receiver file:// loop.
cases.authorization: A receiver has only the delivered HTML: open it, edit visible text, save the primary button, reopen the downloaded sibling, and navigate presentation pages.
cases.expected: the saved HTML remains a full-portable editable artifact with the edited text and the next page visible after reopen

cases.title: Read-only previews carry no delivery authority.
cases.authorization: A client requests render_slide and the renderer legacy wrapper; neither output may be mistaken for an editable delivery artifact.
cases.expected: render_slide has deliverable:false, renderer default is read-only, and neither output contains the Portable payload/positive delivery metadata

cases.title: Delivery reports measured artifact and runtime budgets with explicit large-file behavior.
cases.authorization: A fixed-seed ten-page corpus uses ten different valid noisy PNGs; tests observe all four profiles, reject an oversized artifact/runtime, and retry only with an explicit large-file flag.
cases.expected: resource/raw/runtime metrics are recorded, standard full-portable fits 20 MiB, large artifacts fail without HTML, and allowLargePortable retains full profile with a warning
